items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: when I was up there with Ted and I had to play the way he said he's the boss of the band.

ctx.x: Have you changed your style through the years?
No no no I never changed. The only time my style was changed like I said when I was up there with Ted and I had to play the way he said he's the boss of the band.
